# Simthesizer website

Source of [simthesizer.ai](https://simthesizer.ai), built with
[Docusaurus 3](https://docusaurus.io/).

```bash
cd docs
pnpm install
pnpm start    # dev server on http://localhost:3000
pnpm build    # static build to docs/build/; fails on broken links
pnpm serve    # serve the build; search works only here, not under start
```

- Landing page: `src/pages/index.tsx`; contact page: `src/pages/contact.mdx`.
- Theme colors and fonts: `src/css/custom.css`.
- Docs pages: `docs/`, ordered by `sidebars.ts`. Pages summarize the
  repository's architecture documents and link to them; change behavior there
  first.
- Logo, wordmarks, and favicon: `static/img/`, generated by `scripts/logo.py`
  (see its header for the font and command).
